The doorbell camera pings at 3:12 every night. Every recording shows the same figure, standing perfectly still on my porch with its back to the door.

I told myself it was a prank, until I noticed the date printed on the recordings. It said tomorrow.

Tonight I sat on the porch steps and waited, holding my phone. At 3:12 it pinged, and the new recording showed me from behind, sitting where I sat. Then my front door opened quietly behind me, and something stepped out of the empty house. I felt cold air on my neck, and somewhere inside, the doorbell camera pinged at 3:12.
